description: Search minibus trips offered on busik.ch between two cities on a given travel date. busik.ch connects passengers with independent drivers and small bus operators between Ukraine, Germany and Switzerland (also via Poland, Austria, Czechia). Trips may stop in between; a search also finds the part of a longer trip. Prices are per person. Booking is done by the passenger on busik.ch via booking_url; payment is made directly to the driver. If a city is unknown or ambiguous, the result lists candidates to ask about.

date.description: Travel date (local date at the departure city), ISO 8601, e.g. '2026-10-15'.

language.description: Language for city and stop names: 'de' German (default) or 'uk' Ukrainian.

name: search_trips
title: Search bus trips
